description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SessionStorageNotWritable' used in the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Installer Exception namespace. It extends PHP's built-in Exception class and serves to indicate an error related to session storage permissions.

classes.name: SessionStorageNotWritable
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that session storage is not writable.

methods.description: Inherited constructor from PHP's Exception class, used to create instances of this exception.
